title: Network blind to internal structure of symbols
description: The approach assumes that the network receives only abstract tokens with no access to internal structure (e.g., no decimal notation for numbers, no line notation for permutations), learning solely from interactions.
canonical_description: neural network has no access to internal structure or properties of input symbols, learning only from their interactions

evidence.quote: the network is not made aware of any internal structure of the elements, and has to learn about their properties only from their interactions with other elements.
